description: Find a website's RSS/Atom feeds (declared links and common paths like /feed and /rss.xml) and return the latest items from the first one: title, link, date, summary. Takes 1-5 s. Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.003 per call (x402, USDC on Base).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.
